description: Initialization: Construct by earliest completion, then make a total of 16 times the number of inserted tasks in re-timing attempts. Each attempt selects an inserted task at random and samples a feasible re-timing. Anneal total adjacent transformation time with a linearly decreasing temperature from 1 second, retaining the best visited timeline. Use the supplied random generator.

Reassignment: Remove released observations and apply the same rule to reconsidered tasks. Re-timing can change only observations inserted during this call; other observations stay fixed. Return no change if the complete timeline is unchanged or infeasible.
